title: Metacognitive Therapy Versus Cognitive Behavioral Therapy: A Network Approach
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Limited sample size; - No replication dataset available; - Items used may not fully represent constructs (e.g., metacognition); - No formal statistical tests between network types; - No correction for multiple testing; - Time lag assumed to be one week, other lags not investigated.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention that no replication dataset was available at the time of writing. The study used a weekly measurement schedule, which may not capture rapid within-person dynamics. The centrality indices were reported but not formally tested for significance across networks.
